description: This source file defines a custom JSP tag class 'StoreLogoUrlTag' responsible for generating the URL of a store's logo image, based on merchant store information retrieved from the HTTP request and session. It constructs the URL considering configurations and whether a custom logo exists, defaulting to a placeholder image when necessary.

classes.name: StoreLogoUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that generates the URL for the store's logo image, based on store data and request context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the URL for the store logo image, writes it out, handling default image if logo is missing.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Concludes the custom tag processing, allowing the JSP page to continue.
